entries.subject: The second planet, YSES 1 c
entries.finding: YSES 1 c (Bohn et al. 2020; about 6 Jupiter masses, 1.1 Jupiter radii and 1240 K as Zhang et al. 2024 tabulate) is not built: Roberts et al. (2025, section 5) find that its astrometry is insufficient to constrain its orbit, and a planet in this catalogue is placed by its orbit.
entries.revisitWhen: An orbit of YSES 1 c is published, or GRAVITY astrometry of it is.
